title: Saggar Firing – Mobile Workshop Alternative
source_quote: For our Raku workshops we offer a variety of alternative firings options including Traditional Raku, Horsehair, Saggar, Obvara, and Naked Raku.
evidence_sentence: Saggar firing is offered as part of customizable mobile raku workshops, with saggar creating confined atmospheres in containers.
evidence_quote: Saggar Firing is the method of creating confined atmospheres within a container or saggar.
summary: Saggar firing available through mobile workshops. Saggars create confined atmospheres using refractory clay, newspaper, or other materials depending on the firing type. Book through AlSi's contact page.
cost_text: $75/hour (plus $50 trip charge) · $600 full day · $800 full day with materials
